name: chat-page
title: Chat page
description: A full-page AI assistant: past conversations in the sidebar with a new chat button, the open conversation in a 48rem reading column with replies at its full width, and the one-row composer at the bottom of the same column. With no messages it is the start screen: a large greeting, the composer and suggestion chips. Uses the chat-panel block for the conversation; wire it to @atom63/agent or any runtime through props.

files.content:
import type { ChatComposerStatus } from '@atom63/ui-foundation' import { Button, Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, } from '@atom63/ui-react' import { SquarePen } from 'lucide-react' import type { AnchorHTMLAttributes, ReactElement } from 'react' import { type ChatPanelMessage, ChatThread } from '../../blocks/chat-panel/chat-panel' export const template = { id: 'chat-page', kind: 'page', title: 'Chat page', description: 'A full-page AI assistant: past conversations in the sidebar with a new chat button, the open conversation in a 48rem reading column with replies at its full width, and the one-row composer at the bottom of the same column. With no messages it is the start screen: a large greeting, the composer and suggestion chips. Uses the chat-panel block for the conversation; wire it to @atom63/agent or any runtime through props.', category: 'ai', tags: [ 'chat', 'assistant', 'ai', 'ai assistant', 'agent', 'copilot', 'conversation', 'history', 'start screen', 'suggestions', 'prompt', ], readiness: 'draft', } as const export interface ChatConversation { current?: boolean href: string title: string } export type ChatPageLinkProps = AnchorHTMLAttributes & { href: string } export interface ChatPageProps { /** Past conversations, newest first. */ conversations: readonly ChatConversation[] messages: readonly ChatPanelMessage[] onNewChat?: () => void onSend: (text: string) => void onStop?: () => void /** The product name at the top of the sidebar. */ productName?: string /** Renders a conversation link, for a router's own link component; a plain anchor by default. */ renderLink?: (props: ChatPageLinkProps) => ReactElement status?: ChatComposerStatus suggestions?: readonly string[] } const anchor = ({ children, ...props }: ChatPageLinkProps) => {children} /* * The assistant as the whole page. On a phone the history becomes a sheet the * top-bar toggle opens. The open conversation is marked with aria-current. * The page holds no conversation state; see ChatThread for how to feed it. */ export function ChatPage({ conversations, messages, onNewChat, onSend, onStop, productName = 'Assistant', renderLink = anchor, status, suggestions, }: ChatPageProps) { const current = conversations.find(conversation => conversation.current) return (
{productName}
Recent {conversations.map(conversation => ( {conversation.title}, href: conversation.href, })} /> ))}

{messages.length ? (current?.title ?? 'Chat') : 'New chat'}

) }
